claims.statement: CEG Theorem 2 gives the Euclidean-normalised diagonal lower bound sqrt(alpha^2-1)/(2 sqrt(d)), where alpha is the positive solution of coth(alpha)=alpha; the numerical coefficient is approximately 0.3313717096.
Exploratory exact two-edge block kernel predicts mu_diag candidates above CEG for all d=5..21, by 8.3746% at d=5 and 1.7490% at d=21.

For independent Exp(1) unoriented FPP on Z^d, the sixteen-state one-edge hairpin shortcut first moment and fixed exact rational certificates give Euclidean-normalised diagonal lower bounds for all d=5..21 strictly above CEG. In d=21 the certified lower rational is greater than 0.073854318247, exceeding CEG by at least 2.133946%; in d=5 it exceeds CEG by at least 10.316849%.
